name: Blaze Emberkin
text: Emberkin whose fire burns bright and short. They are quick to anger and quicker to charge.

traits.name: Flashpoint
traits.text: Their Flare deals more damage and can be used twice per fight.

traits.name: Hot Temper
traits.text: Joins tavern brawls readily but fights harder when the town is threatened.

rt.townPerk: Emberroot is easier for alchemists to harvest when Blaze Emberkin help.

name: Burrowkin
text: Small, whiskered tunnel folk who dig snug warrens under the town and hear the ground move.

traits.name: Digger
traits.text: Can dig through soft earth and escape a fight underground.

traits.name: Tremor Ears
traits.text: Hears sappers, burrowing monsters and approaching armies through the ground.

traits.name: Snug
traits.text: Needs little space and shrugs off cold underground.

rt.townPerk: Cellars and mines dig faster, and enemy tunnels under the walls are found early.

name: Cairnborn
text: Grey-skinned hill folk who believe they were carved from burial cairns. They honour the dead and build to last.

traits.name: Stone Skin
traits.text: Takes a little less damage from every weapon blow.

traits.name: Grave Calm
traits.text: Cannot be frightened by undead.

traits.name: Stacker
traits.text: Builds walls and towers faster.

rt.townPerk: Stone walls and graveyards cost less to build and repair.

name: Cinder Emberkin
text: Emberkin whose fire has burned low and grey. They are calm, patient and hard to kill.

traits.name: Ash Skin
traits.text: Takes less damage from fire and acid.

traits.name: Slow Burn
traits.text: Regains health slowly in a long fight.

rt.townPerk: Buildings they tend resist fire during sieges.

name: Dawnward Duskling
text: Dusklings who lean toward morning. They are early risers, hopeful and hard to fool.

traits.name: First Light
traits.text: At dawn, allies near them recover from fear and fatigue.

traits.name: Clear Eyes
traits.text: Resists illusions and charms.

rt.townPerk: Cult agents find Dawnward councillors hard to sway.

name: Duskling
text: Pale-eyed folk who were born in twilight and see best at dusk and dawn. Shadows seem to lean toward them.

traits.name: Gloam Sight
traits.text: Sees in the dark and is not blinded by sudden light.

traits.name: Shadow Step
traits.text: Once per fight, steps from one shadow to another nearby.

traits.name: Quiet Feet
traits.text: Moves silently at night.

rt.townPerk: Night watches with Dusklings spot raiders and smugglers more often.

name: Emberkin
text: Folk with coal-dark skin and eyes like banked fire, said to descend from a forge spirit.

traits.name: Hearth Blood
traits.text: Resists fire and never suffers from cold weather.

traits.name: Forge Hands
traits.text: Smiths and enchanters with Emberkin blood work faster.

traits.name: Flare
traits.text: Can burst into flame once per fight, burning foes around them.

rt.townPerk: Smithies and enchanting forges run hotter, finishing work sooner.

name: Longshank
text: Lanky, long-legged wanderers who cover ground like wading birds. They make the best runners on the frontier.

traits.name: Long Stride
traits.text: Moves faster than most and jumps across gaps others must climb.

traits.name: Runner
traits.text: Can carry messages between town and a distant party in half the usual time.

traits.name: Lookout
traits.text: Sees over crowds and tall grass, spotting ambushes early.

rt.townPerk: Message runners and couriers travel faster.

name: Lowcairn Cairnborn
text: Valley Cairnborn who keep the barrows of the lowlands and guard them from grave robbers.

traits.name: Barrow Sense
traits.text: Knows where the dead are buried and senses undead stirring nearby.

traits.name: Unmoving
traits.text: Cannot be shoved or knocked down while standing still.

rt.townPerk: Undead rise less often from the town's graveyard.

name: Mirefolk
text: Web-toed marsh dwellers who pole flatboats through the fens and smell rain a day early.

traits.name: Fen Stride
traits.text: Moves through mud, reeds and shallow water at full speed.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.text: Can stay underwater for a long time and scout flooded ruins.

traits.name: Weather Nose
traits.text: Warns the town of storms and floods a day before they arrive.

rt.townPerk: Fishing docks and rice paddies yield more with Mirefolk settlers.

name: Peakcairn Cairnborn
text: Mountain Cairnborn who raise watch cairns on high passes and light signal fires on them.

traits.name: Signal Fire
traits.text: Can build a beacon cairn that keeps a region's fog thin.

traits.name: Thin Air
traits.text: Ignores cold and the fatigue of high altitude.

rt.townPerk: Watchtowers built by Peakcairn masons see further.

name: Reedwise Mirefolk
text: Mirefolk of the deep reed beds, keepers of herb lore and swamp reagents.

traits.name: Bog Herbalist
traits.text: Gathers ghostcap and bloodmoss from any wetland site.

traits.name: Swamp Fever Ward
traits.text: Resists disease and poison.

rt.townPerk: Alchemists get a steady trickle of swamp reagents.

name: Saltblood
text: Hardy folk from the salt flats, crusted with pale mineral freckles. Curses and rot slide off them.

traits.name: Salted Flesh
traits.text: Resists necrotic damage and disease.

traits.name: Ward Sweat
traits.text: Undead that bite or claw them take a little radiant damage.

traits.name: Dry Country
traits.text: Needs little water on long expeditions.

rt.townPerk: Wardsalt is cheaper in towns with Saltblood settlers.

name: Thornling
text: Small bark-skinned folk who sprout from hedgerows. They are fiercely loyal to whatever garden they grew in.

traits.name: Bark Hide
traits.text: Natural armour that hardens in sunlight.

traits.name: Root Down
traits.text: Can root in place to heal slowly and resist being moved.

traits.name: Hedge Hide
traits.text: Vanishes among bushes and undergrowth.

rt.townPerk: Gardens, farms and the town green grow faster.

name: Tidecaller Mirefolk
text: River-mouth Mirefolk who read currents and ferry caravans across the fords.

traits.name: Ford Finder
traits.text: Parties with a Tidecaller cross rivers without detours.

traits.name: Swift Swimmer
traits.text: Swims as fast as she walks.

rt.townPerk: River trade roads are cheaper to build and safer to use.

name: Veilborn Duskling
text: Dusklings whose twilight runs deep enough to touch the spirit world.

traits.name: Ghost Sight
traits.text: Can see spirits and invisible creatures at dusk and dawn.

traits.name: Spirit Whisper
traits.text: Can ask a lingering spirit for news of a fogged region.

rt.townPerk: Haunted buildings settle down when a Veilborn lives nearby.
